lines.text: Jesus says stumbling blocks will come, and a millstone and the sea beat causing a little one to stumble.
Jesus tells His disciples to rebuke a brother who sins and to forgive him if he repents.
Forgive a brother who sins and returns ten times a day saying "I repent"; the apostles ask for faith.
Mustard seed faith could make a fig tree be uprooted and planted in the sea.
A servant from the field must prepare his master's meal and serve him, and disciples should call themselves unworthy servants.
